etiology: reactivation of latent herpes simplex virus or varicella zoster virus within geniculate ganglia
epidemiology: annual incidence of 20 to 30 cases per 100,000 persons
risk_factors: genetic predisposition, age, gender, underlying diseases
preventive_measures: vaccination against herpes simplex virus or varicella zoster virus
diagnosis_challenges: nonspecific symptoms, lack of early biomarkers, disease mimics
treatment_challenges: poor adherence, side effects, drug resistance
